t: Jeyes classic fluid is a concentrated outdoor disinfectant, ideal for maintaining clean and hygienic outdoor spaces. It effectively tackles algae, mould, and stubborn stains found on water butts, greenhouses, garden tools, and paving. This powerful formula disinfects surfaces, killing 99.9% of bacteria and viruses, making it suitable for professional use in various trade applications. The fluid removes dirt and grime, leaving behind its distinctive, familiar phenolic aroma. A single litre offers substantial coverage, making it a cost-effective solution for extensive cleaning tasks.
b: Classic Formula Removes Dirt, Grime & Stains
Concentrated; Makes Large Volumes Of Cleaner
Suitable For Patios, Paths & Garden Tools
